editorial.thesis: A learning-and-leisure city of about 980,000. Its retail is heavy on coaching & training and grocery & daily needs, and thin on desserts, sweets & ice cream and apparel, footwear & jewellery — and 67% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 47% of Raipur's. 6.73 chain outlets per lakh residents against 14.41 in Raipur; 20 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Apollo Pharmacy 12, Domino's 9, Bata 7.

The mapped economy leans to education. Shares of all mapped places: education 15.1% (Raipur 9.9%); leisure & entertainment 3.7% (Raipur 2.9%); offices 9.0% (Raipur 12.4%); other services 6.0% (Raipur 7.9%). Raw counts would mislead because Raipur is mapped more completely (10,835 places against 4,047), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 8 zones hold 67% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Nawagaon alone has about 175,000 residents and 41 mapped food & drink places.
Retail is less concentrated than in Raipur. 51% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Raipur 52%). The largest cores are Supela (542 places) and Motilal Nehru Nagr (464).

The widest brand gaps against Raipur. Apollo Pharmacy 12 outlets vs 27; Domino's 9 outlets vs 23; Café Coffee Day 1 outlets vs 13. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 8 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Raipur, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Nawagaon and Supela are the largest zones by residents (175,000 and 157,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 51% of all commercial places, and Supela alone lists 542.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Motilal Nehru Nagr holds 23 of the 66 tracked chain outlets, and Supela adds 14.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Nawagaon and Motilal Nehru Nagr lead on education places (113 and 70, with 50 and 27 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Nawagaon and Jawahar. The blue cores include Supela.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (10,835 places in Raipur against 4,047 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Raipur; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Raipur, Bhilai's mapped places over-index on education (15.1% vs 9.9%), leisure & entertainment (3.7% vs 2.9%), grocery & daily needs (1.6% vs 1.3%) and under-index on offices (9.0% vs 12.4%), other services (6.0% vs 7.9%), services & crafts (5.7% vs 6.8%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 66 outlets of 20 tracked national brands within 8 km — 6.73 per lakh residents against Raipur's 14.41 (187 outlets of 34 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Raipur are Apollo Pharmacy (12 vs 27); Domino's (9 vs 23); Café Coffee Day (1 vs 13). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Raipur's, so low means thin by Raipur's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 8 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Bhilai's age mix against Raipur: children (0–14) 26.3% vs 29.3%, 15–24 19.9% vs 20.2%, working age 45.6% vs 43.2%, 60+ 8.2% vs 7.4%. Under-25s are 46% of residents.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 4.6% of mapped places against 4.2% in Raipur, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 9 (Raipur 23), KFC 2 (Raipur 9), Pizza Hut 1 (Raipur 9), Burger King 1 (Raipur 1). No mapped outlet in either city: Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.7% of mapped places against 2.2% in Raipur — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 1 (Raipur 13). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Sutta Bar, Chai Point, Blue Tokai.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.5% of mapped places against 0.6% in Raipur, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Naturals 1 (Raipur 2). No mapped outlet in either city: Havmor, Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.6% of mapped places against 1.3% in Raipur — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: DMart 4 (Raipur 8), Vishal Mega Mart 2 (Raipur 3), Reliance Smart / Fresh 1 (Raipur 6), Spencer's 1 (Raipur 1). No mapped outlet in either city: More, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 1.6% of mapped places against 1.4% in Raipur — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Apollo Pharmacy 12 (Raipur 27). No mapped outlet in either city: Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 6.0% of mapped places against 6.4% in Raipur, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Bata 7 (Raipur 9), Tanishq 7 (Raipur 6), Reliance Trends 5 (Raipur 9), Raymond 4 (Raipur 12). No mapped outlet in either city: Zudio, V-Mart.
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 8.2% of mapped places against 8.6% in Raipur, so the mix is level.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 5.1% of mapped places against 3.5% in Raipur — above its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 3.9% of mapped places against 4.0% in Raipur, so the mix is level.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
